update_definition.initial_Wnorm: frozen Attempt201 initial_Wnorm, exactly verified at F
update_definition.arithmetic: CPU float64 W - eta*grad, one FP32 cast per matrix
update_definition.selection: first accepted factor in fixed descending order, training objective only
update_definition.restore: exact original F before every trial; same cloned FP32 aggregate gradient reused
update_definition.failure: restore exact F, abort without candidate or privileged access

candidate_definition.delta_arithmetic: float32 subtraction then float64 vocabulary centering
candidate_definition.centering: subtract the float64 mean over the full vocabulary independently for each prompt
